walkthroughs.body_html:
Law of supply: when price goes up, supply goes up.

High prices = bigger profit per item = sellers make more.

Supply shifts because of:

  • Cost of inputs — flour gets pricey, bakers make less bread.
  • Technology — new ovens bake faster.
  • Weather — bad weather wrecks crops.
  • Taxes/subsidies from government.

The supply curve slopes up — left to right.

Higher price, higher quantity supplied. 📈

Together with the demand curve, it sets the market price.
